## Story

<div class="reader-page">

<div class="reader-text">

Mira and Milo are mice. They live in a field. Their home is a small hole. One night, the wind howls.

</div>

<div class="reader-sidebar">

## Think About It

1. Why do the mice leave their home? (Rain floods the hole.) 2. Where do they find a new home? (In a wood pile.) 3. What do they do to make it nice? (They line it with cloth and grass.) 4. Find a silent E word.
